specs.Connector Type: USB Type A, USB Type C

features: 【All-in-One & Multi-Port Charger】Just a 3-port USB C charger can perfectly upgrade your charging configuration. With 2 USB-C ports and 1 USB-A port, making it easy to fast charge phones, ipads, and laptops simultaneously. Charging output power depends on different port combinations, allowing you to achieve the best performance and get the fastest charging time based on actual charging needs.

【Efficient & Fast Charging】65W USB C charger to charge your device at lightning-fast speeds, with a single device output of up to 65W. It takes just 2 hours to fully charge your MacBook Pro and only 25 minutes to charge your iPhone up to 55%. This USB C charger block supports PD3.0, QC3.0, unlocking the best charging effect and bringing you the most efficient and fastest charging experience.

【Compact & Portable Design】Type C 65W wall charger adopts small and compact design, which is 50% smaller than the official charger, making it lightweight and easy to carry. The small charger contains GaN technology and can be conveniently placed in your bag to meet all your charging needs when traveling without worrying about adding baggage burden, allowing you to enjoy a high-efficiency charging life.

【Safe & Reliable】Built-in intelligent chip enables the smart adjustment of output voltage, current, and power via PPS technology when multiple devices are charged at the same time, higher charge conversion efficiency, lower temperature, and safe for use.
【BIS Certified】The adapter is BIS certified for safety and reliability, ensuring that it meets the highest standards for quality and performance.
